This job is with United Nations, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
Result of Service
The Urban Mobility Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the coordination of the project, the operational and technical teams of UN-Habitat offices in Rio de Janeiro, as well as with the local project team.
Work Location
Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, Brazil
Expected duration
Five (5) months
Duties and Responsibilities
Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. UN-Habitat is starting a project with the municipality of Congonhas, Minas Gerais, in cooperation with the Municipal Planning and Management Department. This project aims to revise the Master Plan and develop the city's Mobility Plan. To achieve the proposed objective, the "Congonhas 2030+2" project is designed to strengthen public capacity and promote a culture of transparent decision-making based on data and information. This will be achieved through diagnostics, analysis, training and the drafting of plans. The Master Plan and the Mobility Plan will be drawn up with the participation of society, configuring them as social pacts that take into account its interpretation of the strengths, potential and challenges of the city's spaces, seeking to improve the population's quality of life. In order to properly implement the project, as well as UN-Habitat's mandate in Brazil, UN-Habitat is looking for an Urban Mobility Consultant. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Urban Mobility Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Urban Mobility Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Be available for a minimum of one (1) weekly virtual meeting with the project coordination, aiming at: I. Sharing partial results of each deliverable; II. Being readily available to incorporate revisions pointed out by the UN-Habitat team in the ongoing activities; III. Defining with the project coordination a feasible workplan, considering intermediary deliveries prior each product deadline, allowing the UN-Habitat team to review the content prior to its approval for payment; IV. Supporting project planning. b) Consider that achieving the completion of each Product on the expected delivery date depends on the Consultant’s ability and commitment to present partial results, following a detailed timeline to be validated with the project coordination in the first week after signing the contract. Overall, the Consultant shall guarantee the execution of its activities accordingly to the main project schedule, being responsible for the deliverables according to deadlines. c) Be available to oversee field work and participate in public events related to the participatory process of developing the Mobility Plan. d) Reports and documents must be developed using the project templates that the UN-Habitat team will provide, in the .ppt, .doc and .indd formats. e) Arrange the software and equipment required to the development of its activities. f) Maintain an orderly and accessible information file system on the information and data produced. g) Arrange equipment to carry out the field work, including film cameras. h) Ensure that the technical activities are aligned with the quality expectations of UN-Habitat and the project counterpart. The Consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The Consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Urban Mobility Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Report on Participatory Engagement Activities – Mobility Plan Expected completion date: 30 days after contract signature The following activities must be performed: a. Preparing documents for the participatory diagnostics process of the Municipal Mobility Plan (presentations, booklets, banners, etc.). b. Supporting the creation of internet content. c. Participating in regional workshops, when requested by the UN-Habitat team. d. Participating in thematic workshops in the municipality: public transport, active mobility, road traffic for people and freight, among others. e. Providing support for an online public consultation. f. Systematizing the results obtained from all the participatory activities carried out. Product 2: Final Plan and draft for the law Expected completion date: 90 days after contract signature The following activities must be performed: a. Consolidation of the Municipal Urban Mobility Plan (technical document). b. Participation in the feedback public hearing. c. Consolidation of the draft of the law and submission to the City Council.
Qualifications/special Skills
Education Required:

  • Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Engineering, Urban Studies, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant technical experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Urban Studies, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields. Work experience:
  • A minimum of six (6) years of experience providing technical support for the development of urban mobility plans and projects is required.
  • Professional experience developing urban mobility plans and projects and other initiatives related to sustainable urban mobility in municipalities with characteristics similar to Congonhas, Minas Gerais, is required.
  • Professional/academic knowledge on themes related to sustainable urban mobility, public transport, road infrastructure, and initiatives focused on prioritizing active transport for pedestrians is desirable.
  • Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
  • Excellent writing and proof-reading skills in Portuguese is required.
  • Good computer skills in Windows, as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines is required.
  • Good command of geographical information systems (GIS) software, such as QGIS, MapInfo and ArcGIS, is desirable. Competencies
  • Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
  • Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
  • Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
  • Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
  • The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
  • The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
  • The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
  • The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
  • The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
  • The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
  • The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
  • English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
  • For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of Spanish and English is desirable.

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

title: Reservoir Engineer
description:
The position involves supporting all reservoir engineering activities, including oil and gas reserve estimation, production forecasting, reservoir simulation, and production optimization, while also demonstrating an understanding of geoscience concepts, drilling, completions, and production operations.

• Expert in integrated reservoir simulation studies, including data analysis and integration, model construction, history matching, calibration and predictions.

• Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both NPV and hydrocarbon recovery.

• Competent in the analysis of capillary pressure, relative permeability and PVT data.

• Competent in compositional reservoir modeling.

• Participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.

• Evaluates and initiates exploitation opportunities, including new drilling and work-overs to maximize reserves recovery and booking, and overall play economics.

• Prepare data and perform PTA interpretation and modeling.

• Formulate the strategies for reservoir development, data acquisition, field surveillance and monitor masterplans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.

• Extensive working knowledge of standard vendor applications for pre and post-processing of simulation data and Assisted History Matching software and workflows.

• Is familiar with field production activities to effectively implement reservoir management aspects during the field production phase, including liaison with regulatory agencies.

• Develop Life of Field production profiles and maintain auditable booked reserves estimates and reserves reports

• Coordinate and integrate data, simulation and studies between Artificial lift, production, and dynamic modeling to support the other areas.

• Work with the Production Engineer/Technologist to optimize well potentials.

• Write concise reports for all studies and maintain comprehensive, accessible and up-to-date records of input and interpreted data.

• Coordinates with the business development on acquisition and divestiture projects. Supports the reservoir engineering evaluation component of company acquisition


Education

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Petroleum Engineering.

• Long relevant experience may compensate for formal education

Experience

• Minimum 5 years of experience with reservoir engineering within the oil and gas industry.

• Reservoir engineering, reservoir management and reservoir simulation skills are essential.

• Proven track record in performing reservoir modeling and field development studies.

• Pressure transient analysis (PTA) interpretation experience will be a plus.
Knowledge

• High proficiency in any reservoir simulation software (Eclipse or T-Nav preferred)

• Proficiency in any production software like Pipesim and/or Prosper.

• Experience with any pressure transient analysis software like Kappa or Pansystem.

HR Professional | Passionate about Culture, Growth & People

Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

Grupo EP Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Estamos Muito Felizes Com o Seu Interesse Em Embarcar Em Uma Jornada Com Propósito Na EP. Antes De Tudo, Queremos Que Você Conheça Um Pouco Mais Sobre Quem Somos e o Impacto Que Geramos
Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade , atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
Com mais de 50 anos de existência, estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país.
Já ajudamos nossos clientes a tratarem mais de 700 milhões de m³ de efluentes — o equivalente ao consumo anual de água de 12 milhões de pessoas (toda a população do Estado de SP).
Contamos com mais de 500 colaboradores , atuando em 5 frentes especializadas : Analítica, Engenharia, Equipamentos, Química e Tech.
Nosso objetivo é claro: expandir nossa atuação em todo o Brasil até 2033 .

Falo e faço
Aqui, a coerência entre discurso e prática é essencial. Transparência, ética e responsabilidade norteiam nosso relacionamento com clientes, parceiros e colegas.
Visto a camisa
Estamos em busca de pessoas comprometidas, que se conectem com nosso propósito e tenham orgulho de fazer parte dessa transformação ambiental.
Hoje melhor que ontem
Acreditamos no poder da melhoria contínua. Pequenas evoluções diárias nos tornam uma empresa melhor e mais relevante para o mundo.
Se você também é #MOVIDOAAGUA e deseja fazer a diferença com o seu trabalho, vem com a gente!
Missão do cargo: As operações terceirizadas tem como responsabilidade garantir o perfeito funcionamento das estações de tratamento do nosso cliente, a fim de não poluir o meio ambiente, atendendo as legislações ambientais e oferecendo água de qualidade para uso em processos internos, quando necessário.
Como Será Seu Dia a Dia
Atuar na área operacional de estações de tratamentos de água e efluentes (industriais e domésticos) e reuso de água, mantendo em perfeito funcionamento;
Realizar monitoramento dos volumes dos tanques;
Realizar leitura de temperatura, pH, turbidez, Resíduos Sedimentáveis e Sedimentabilidade do lodo, de acordo com os procedimentos internos;
Preparar e repor produtos químicos inerentes ao processo de tratamento;
Preencher planilhas de controle – trabalho diário e controle de qualidade;
Verificar indicadores de funcionamento;

Realizar análises químicas de baixa complexidade;
Prezar pela organização e manutenção do ambiente de trabalho;
Manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Curso Técnico em Química, Meio Ambiente ou áreas correlatas;
CRQ ativo;
Experiência mínima de 1 ano com tratamento de água/ efluentes.

Comprometimento e ética junto ao time e cliente.

The Business Unit Leader guides their team to success by focusing on sustainability in people, profit, and the planet. Their roles include:

  • Detecting and developing talent for career growth within the Shop, supporting business needs through talent export.
  • Supporting Shop decisions amidst uncertainty and challenges.
  • Regular coaching and feedback to improve team performance.
  • Providing performance feedback and development suggestions for support team members.

Passionate about developing people, viewing the plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and growth. Responsibilities include:

  • Promoting lifelong learning through competency evaluations and development plans.
  • Ensuring development via Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  • Utilizing accessible career paths for all employees.
  • Building diverse teams and supporting competency development through mentoring and coaching.

Representing the Plant, embodying company values by:

  • Living the values visibly and inspiring employees.

  • Aligning shop-level vision with site-wide goals.
  • Addressing employee issues promptly and ensuring timely attendance management.
  • Fostering safety as a core value, with each employee responsible for safety.

4. Customer & Business Partner Focus

Understanding customer needs and guiding teams to be customer-centric. Expectations include:

  • Understanding customer requirements and the Business Unit's role in meeting them.
  • Driving economic value creation.
  • Collaborating with local teams on industrialization, digitalization, and transformation projects.

5. Environment Promoter

Actively promoting sustainability and environmental responsibility by:

  • Fostering a culture valuing sustainability.
  • Implementing environmental and biodiversity strategies.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment Role Model

Leading with the ICARE model, inspiring and coaching teams to:

  • Embed ICARE principles throughout the Business Unit.
  • Create an inclusive, safe, and collaborative environment.
  • Encourage empowerment and collective responsibility for the plant’s future.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  • Activities follow MMW practices for sustained performance.
  • Continuous improvement through variation and waste reduction.
  • Meeting SMQDC performance standards.
  • Empowering teams with increasing autonomy and responsibility.
  • Applying sound problem-solving methodologies.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation Contributor

Driving digital transformation by:

  • Encouraging digital tool adoption and data-driven approaches.
  • Building necessary foundations for transformation, including data quality and organizational alignment.
  • Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with strategy and sharing best practices.

About the job (D) LATAM Territory Manager

Overview

As a Territory Manager , you will be responsible for building relationships with high-value prospective customers. You will develop a deep understanding of their organizational structure, key influencers, and decision-makers. You will manage the entire sales cycle, negotiate pricing, and coordinate with our engineering and internal resources to close deals successfully. Additionally, you will provide continuous feedback to our product team to ensure we develop features that truly meet our customers' needs.

About the Team

We are a passionate team that thrives on challenges and is dedicated to making people's lives better. We value:

  • Openness Encouraging transparency and honest communication.
  • Curiosity Always seeking to learn and improve.
  • Continuous improvement Striving to evolve and adapt.
  • Empowerment Giving every team member the autonomy to drive impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and nurture relationships with high-value prospective customers.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals.
  • Negotiate pricing and business terms with various stakeholders, including senior management, procurement, and C-level executives.
  • Build consensus and urgency within customer organizations to close six-figure deals.
  • Work closely with engineering and internal teams to align product offerings with customer needs.
  • Provide feedback to the product team to help shape future features.
  • Drive urgency in customers to shorten the sales cycle.

Requirements

  • Experience: Minimum 4+ years of proven experience selling technical commercial or enterprise SaaS solutions (Marketing technology experience preferred).
  • Track Record: Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales targets in a competitive environment.
  • Sales Cycle Expertise: Experience selling SaaS solutions with 120+ day sales cycles.
  • Deal Management: Ability to manage complex enterprise sales cycles from start to finish, including engaging with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Negotiation Skills: Skilled in negotiating business terms with line-of-business leaders, procurement teams, senior management, and C-level executives.
  • Education: Must have a Bachelor's degree. Previous Sales Methodology training is a plus.
  • Language Skills: Fluent in Spanish and/or Portuguese.
  • Regional Expertise: Experience selling to enterprise organizations in Central and South America.
  • Partnerships: Proven ability to build partner relationships in the region.
  • ️ Unlimited vacation time (minimum 3 weeks encouraged per year).
  • Competitive compensation package , including stock options.
  • Fully remote Work from anywhere.
  • ️ Work-from-home stipend to set up your home office.
  • Apple laptop provided for new employees.
  • Training & development budget , refreshed annually.
  • Parental leave for qualified employees.
  • Collaborate with smart, talented professionals who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

title: MÉDICO OFTALMOLOGISTA (GLAUCOMA) - CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO - RJ
description:
Job description

O CENTRO CARIOCA DO OLHO está localizado na região central da cidade, no Bairro de Benfica. Os serviços prestados abrangem toda a população carioca, residente da cidade. É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida.

A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como:

·diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas;

·realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual;

·avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual;

·programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão;

·ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde.

·realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação.

Coordenar a fim de garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade. Acompanhar, analisar e tratar os relatórios e atendimentos necessários para o cumprimento das metas, prazos e melhorias.


Main responsibilities

Realizar atividades na especialidade de oftalmologia, prevenir, diagnosticar e tratar das doenças e distúrbios dos olhos e visão, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal de Saúde.


Requirements and skills

Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina. Residência Médica ou Título de Especialista em Oftalmologia. Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovada como Médico Oftalmologista;

Especialista em Segmento Posterior com comprovante de Estagio (Fellowship) em Segmento Posterior ou Carta de Serviço ou Especialista na Área.


Additional information

  • Local de Trabalho: Benfica - RJ
  • Carga Horária: 12h semanais
  • Regime de contratação CLT
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

title: Supervisor(a) de Produção
description:
The Business Unit Leader leads their team towards success in creating sustainable people, profit, and planet value, by adopting the following roles:

1. Member of the Operations team

The Business Unit Leader aspires to drive the performance of the Shop first, even before their own Business Unit. They are actively involved in:

  1. Sharing best practices between Business Units and contributing to Plant performance in a collaborative manner, maintaining a "ONE MANUFACTURING TEAM" mindset.
  2. Detecting and developing talents to grow their careers in the Shop, exporting talent to support business needs.
  3. Supporting Shop decisions even under uncertainty and unfavorable circumstances.
  4. Improving Business Unit performance through coaching and feedback.
  5. Providing input on support team members' performance and development recommendations.

2. People developer

The Business Unit Leader is passionate about developing people, viewing their plant as a platform for recruitment, training, and professional growth. They are expected to:

  1. Promote a lifelong learning mindset by evaluating competencies and identifying development opportunities.
  2. Ensure development through Spoke training and social promotion projects.
  3. Utilize accessible career paths for all employees.
  4. Build and believe in diverse teams.
  5. Support competency development via mentoring and coaching.

3. Representative/Role model of Company values, purpose & strategy

The Business Unit Leader embodies the group's values and represents the Plant to employees by:

  1. Living out values and inspiring through behavior.
  2. Motivating teams using Michelin purpose & Dream.
  3. Ensuring understanding of the Plant strategy and individual roles in collective success.
  4. Aligning the shop vision and engaging teams to realize it.
  5. Addressing employee issues timely and ensuring accurate attendance records.
  6. Developing Safety as a core value, ensuring responsibility for safety among employees.

4. Customer & business partner

The Business Unit Leader understands customer needs and guides teams to be customer-centric. They are expected to:

  1. Understand customer requirements and their role in meeting expectations.
  2. Focus on all aspects of economic value creation.
  3. Support business through collaboration on industrialization, digitalization, and industry transformations.

5. Environment promoter

The Business Unit Leader promotes sustainability and environmental impact reduction by:

  1. Fostering a culture valuing sustainability and environment.
  2. Implementing strategies for environmental impact and biodiversity.

CARE AREA of EXCELLENCE

6. ICARE & Empowerment role model

Leading with the ICARE leadership model, inspiring and coaching teams to progress by:

  1. Inspiring passion for ICARE at all levels.
  2. Creating inclusive, safe, collaborative, and intelligent team environments.
  3. Fostering empowerment and engagement in plant evolution and transformation.

7. Operational Excellence Leader

Developing operational excellence by ensuring:

  1. Activities apply MMW practices, creating sustainable foundations for performance.
  2. Continuous progress through variation and non-value tasks reduction.
  3. Achievement of SMQDC performance levels and standards compliance.
  4. Team empowerment, increased autonomy, and responsibility.
  5. Effective problem-solving to eliminate root causes.

TECH AREA of EXCELLENCE

8. Digital and Innovation contributor

Driving innovation, engineering, and technology transformation by:

  1. Encouraging digital application use and data-driven approaches.
  2. Building foundations for transformation (data quality, skills, organization, roadmap).
  3. Supporting projects that develop capabilities aligned with Michelin strategy, promoting digital best practices.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit.

Carta’s fund administration platform supports nearly 7,000 funds and SPVs, representing $150B in assets under administration in venture capital and private equity. Trusted by more than 40,000 companies, Carta also helps private businesses in over 160 countries manage their cap tables, valuations, taxes, equity programs, compensation, and more.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page .

The Problems You'll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You
  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 5+ years of experience in an Automation Engineering role
  • Strong ability and expertise in creating automated tests in Python and Selenium
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools like CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker
  • Strong experience with automation design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify patterns and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands-on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please note: Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

Who We are?

Why Join Us?

As a Site Engineer in ALEC Building, you’ll be at the heart of delivering iconic structures. Our team shapes landmark projects from foundation to finish - providing the space and support for you to take ownership, lead boldly, and build excellence into every detail.

As a Civil Site Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing and executing on-site construction activities to ensure work is completed on time, within budget, and in compliance with project specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements. This role involves coordinating with project teams, managing materials and documentation, inspecting work progress, resolving technical issues, and supporting project handover processes.

About Your Team

This role sits within the Operations Department and reports directly to the Site Manager. The department is responsible for the daily business activities, ensuring efficiency, quality, and smooth workflow across all functions. It focuses on process improvement, resource optimization, and timely service delivery.

Your Role

As a Site Engineer, you will:

  • Ensure site works comply with contract specs, quality, and safety standards.
  • Prepare material submittals and track approvals.
  • Develop method statements and risk assessments.
  • Monitor procurement schedules and follow up on deliveries.
  • Control approved drawings and as-built documentation.
  • Inspect works, raise inspection requests, and coordinate with site teams.
  • Report progress, delays, and site issues to senior management.
  • Support testing, commissioning, and project close-out documentation.
  • This role is full time and follows a Monday to Saturday work week, typical for project-based positions in our industry

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of project site experience, ideally within construction or Data Center Solutions environments.
  • Knowledge: Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Engineering degree (Mechanical / Electrical) with ≥ 10 years’ site experience.
  • Solid understanding of contract specifications, QA/QC, HSE and programme controls.
  • Proven ability to manage materials, documentation and productivity on fast-track projects.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and pressure-handling skills; proactive mindset.
  • Familiarity with BIM-enabled field tools or Lean construction principles.

What We Offer

· The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects.

· A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.

· Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.
